description: This file defines platform-specific functions for checking firmware images, performing upgrades, and copying configurations based on the board type within an OpenWRT project. It contains conditional logic for different hardware models and invokes external scripts or functions accordingly.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if a firmware image is compatible with the detected board, calling board-specific check functions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the appropriate upgrade procedure based on the board type, calling board-specific or generic upgrade functions.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data for specific boards after upgrade.
